origin: Built by Muse (AI assistant) on 18 November 2026 at Steven Powell's direction, from his line in the Everyday Cool ideas side chat — 'language is a code too (ala secret squares)' — with contents named by him: a map of language families built on the surprise that English is Germanic, common cognates, a mini translator, and STEM articles; the build brief added a 'where language lives' brain section. The room carries: an explorable Indo-European family tree (21 nodes; English's ancestry PIE → Germanic → West Germanic → Anglo-Frisian → English, the French layer stated as post-1066 borrowing, not ancestry) with five 'other great families' cards whose counts are labelled approximate; a cognates bench of eleven word families listing genuine descendants of the starred PIE roots only, with the known traps (Russian отец, Spanish hermano, Latin aqua) as false-friend warnings; a phrasebook of ten phrases in six languages, honestly labelled and cross-linked beside it to Steven's separate Travel Kit app (releases page verified HTTP 200); a schematic brain bench (Broca's area, Wernicke's area, arcuate fasciculus, visual word form area) cross-linked to Everyday Body; a 'Language is a code' section cross-linked with Secret Squares both ways (the reciprocal card in Secret Squares is recorded there as a collection-only local change); and a thirteen-link shelf, every link checked live 18 November 2026 (Omniglot verified by reading the page after it refused scripted checks with 403). This folder is the maintained original.
